source: Attributed context warehouse: GreatFire Analyzer (CC BY 4.0), OONI, China Digital Times RSS, Weiboscope citation
scope: Peer verdicts for URLs Palimpsest already holds. Palimpsest is not the origin of these measurements. Weiboscope's 2012 dump is not on this node.
method: GreatFire lookups are cached by the greatfire-context job. OONI is an exact host join against already-held ooni-gfw-latest / ooni-bulk warehouse objects. CDT keeps titles, links, and excerpts bounded at 280 characters. Weiboscope is a documented abstention.

greatfire.source: GreatFire Analyzer open API (https://en.greatfire.org/data), CC BY 4.0
greatfire.method: Keyless /api/url/ and /api/verdict lookups for already-held Palimpsest URLs. Per-test history discarded. Not a 700k catalog crawl.
